Code Review ✅ Approved 🟡 Medium risk · Separating indexless tool calls enables auto-execution of each provider-generated command; incorrect call boundaries could run unintended commands. Fixes streamed tool calls from Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint being merged together when the provider omits the `index` field. `ToolCallDelta.Index` becomes a `*int`, and unindexed deltas now start a new call when they bring a differing id or a name without an id, otherwise they continue the latest call. No issues found.
